exercises.description: Work with lists using advanced operations.
instructions: Get list length and log it

exercises.solution:
*** Settings ***

*** Test Cases ***
List Operations
    ${numbers}    Create List    1    2    3

hints: Append To List modifies the list in place
First argument is the list variable
Second argument is the item to append
Get Length returns the number of items

exercises.title: Dictionary Operations
instructions: Create dictionary ${user} with name=John and age=30
Get value for key 'name' and log it
exercises.initialCode:

*** Test Cases ***

    # Write your code here
exercises.solution:
*** Settings ***
Library    Collections

*** Test Cases ***
Dict Operations
    ${user}    Create Dictionary    name=John    age=30
    ${name}    Get From Dictionary    ${user}    name
    Log    ${name}
hints: Create Dictionary uses key=value syntax
Get From Dictionary takes dict and key
Dictionary keys are strings
You can also use &{dict}[key] syntax
